Technical SEO.title: Google November 2026 Core Update Begins Rolling Out
Technical SEO.summary: The November 2026 Google core update has begun rolling out globally, as noted in the daily search forum recap. Publishers are bracing for potential traffic shifts as the update propagates.

Technical SEO.title: Google Crawled/Discovered - Currently Not Indexed A Site Quality Issue
Technical SEO.summary: John Mueller reiterated that a status of Crawled/Discovered - Currently Not Indexed in Google Search Console page indexing reports may indicate Google considers those pages or the broader site low-quality. This is a direct signal for enterprise SEO teams managing large-scale indexation.

Technical SEO.title: Google: How Moving to a CDN Can Accidentally Overwhelm Your Website
Technical SEO.summary: Gary Illyes and Chery Prommawin explain that migrating to a CDN can trigger a sudden spike in Googlebot crawling activity that may overload the origin server and risk accidentally blocking Google crawlers. The video is the final installment in the Non-Canonical Cabinet series.

Technical SEO.title: Google Placing Source Icons At Bottom Of AI Overviews
Technical SEO.summary: Google is testing moving AI Overview citation icons from the top to the very bottom of the answer block, which may make sources harder to find and could further reduce click-through to publisher sites. This UI change has direct implications for organic traffic from AI Overview appearances.

Technical SEO.title: Google Search AI Overview Definitions Expanded By Default
Technical SEO.summary: Google is now expanding AI Overviews for definition queries by default, removing the need for users to click Show more to see the full answer. This change applies to all definition searches and extends the earlier dynamic expansion behaviour Google had already confirmed.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: AI Shopping Errors: What To Fix To Help Shoppers Choose Your Products
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: The article explores how AI affects product visibility and consumer decision-making in retail search, identifying errors that can hurt a product's chances of being surfaced by AI shopping tools. Relevant for enterprise brands managing product discoverability across AI-driven commerce surfaces.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: Visibility Gets You On The List, Evidence Helps You Stay There
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: The piece argues that AI visibility alone is insufficient and that evidence gaps around integrations, workflows, and outcomes can weaken AI-generated recommendations over time. Directly applicable to enterprise GEO strategies that go beyond initial citation into sustained AI answer presence.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: AI search is changing faster than marketing teams can keep up, despite increased spend
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: A report released on November 11 2026 highlights that marketing teams are struggling to adapt to the pace of AI search evolution even as budgets for AI search activities increase. This signals an operational and strategic gap relevant to enterprise teams building GEO programmes.

AI Search / GEO.title: The 100 Most Mentioned Brands in ChatGPT (November 2026)
AI Search / GEO.summary: Ahrefs analysed 5.5 million US ChatGPT answers and ranked brands by mention frequency, finding Walmart leads with appearances in 95,605 answers, nearly twice that of second-placed Target, with carmakers accounting for 15 entries in the broader ranking. Directly useful for benchmarking automotive and retail brand presence in LLM answer surfaces.

AI Search / GEO.title: OpenAI gives brands ChatGPT traffic data, but affiliate sales remain invisible
AI Search / GEO.summary: OpenAI is now providing brands with data on traffic generated through ChatGPT, but downstream affiliate conversion data is not included in what is shared. This measurement gap is a critical consideration for enterprise travel and retail brands evaluating ROI from AI search referrals.

AI Search / GEO.title: Discourse sees itself well positioned for the AI search era versus Reddit
AI Search / GEO.summary: Discourse published a comparison of its incentive model against Reddit's, positioning open forum content as better suited for AI search indexing and citation. Relevant for enterprise content strategists considering community and forum signals in GEO planning.

AI Search / GEO.title: Impact of Expired Google PageRank Patent on Search Results
AI Search / GEO.summary: The article examines what the expiry of the original PageRank patent means for search and open-source developers building search tools. Tangentially relevant for SEO practitioners tracking the evolving authority signal landscape as AI search gains ground.
